entities.name: James
entities.description: One of the two friends in this conversation. A programmer who works in Python and C++ and took up coding in college, a lifelong gamer and game maker, owner of the dogs Max, Daisy and Ned, and a Liverpool supporter. He and John were friends as ten-year-old skateboarders. Over 2022 he finished a game project he had wanted to make since childhood, built a virtual world, took a game-development course, built and released a Unity strategy game, took up extreme sports, cooking and streaming, travelled to Canada and Greenland, and began a relationship with Samantha and moved in with her.

entities.name: John
entities.description: The other friend in this conversation. He learned HTML and CSS years before and signed up for a programming course in March 2022, plays CS:GO, chess, drums and board games, reads science fiction and epic fantasy, and detects metal on beaches. Over 2022 he left a three-year IT job for a new one, turned toward organising esports tournaments as a career, volunteered his coding for charities, taught his younger siblings and then his parents to code, released his first mobile game, and won the regional chess tournament on 1 November 2022. He has siblings, parents and someone called Jill, and wants a dog but has never had one.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.description: The woman James met at a dog owners' beach outing on 9 August 2022, who left him her phone number. He asked her to be his girlfriend at the theatre on 3 September 2022 and she agreed; by 31 October 2022 they had decided to move in together and rented an apartment near McGee's bar. She loves the theatre and a good lager.

entities.name: Jill
entities.description: Someone close to John, named by James as 'your Jill' on 22 July 2022 when he brought souvenirs back from his Canada trip for both of them; John said she would be delighted.

entities.name: James's sister
entities.description: James's sister, with whom he says he is blessed to have a close bond. She visited him and his dogs on 21 July 2022, and the two of them were by the ocean the same day and watched a sunset together.

entities.name: James's mother
entities.description: James's mother, who served in the army. She visited James on 19 October 2022 with an army friend, and the two of them used to tell him stories about their time in the military and about their dog; their old Nintendo console was James's first gaming system.

entities.name: Josh
entities.description: A friend of James, visited together with Mark during the road trip James took with his family in early November 2022.

entities.name: Mark
entities.description: A friend of James, visited together with Josh during the road trip James took with his family in early November 2022.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: One of James's three dogs, lovable and playful and a source of joy to James especially in tough times. He is a strong swimmer who loves the beach and the lake, never misses a frisbee in mid-air, and walks with James on a trail a mile from the house.

entities.name: Daisy
entities.description: One of James's three dogs, a Labrador who loves playing with her toys and, most of all, eating. She can sit, stay, give a paw and roll over, and often lies down beside James while he games.

entities.name: Ned
entities.description: The puppy James adopted from an animal shelter in Stamford in the week before 12 April 2022, making three dogs in the household. James introduced him to Max and Daisy on 17 June 2022 and took him to the clinic on 5 August 2022 for a routine examination and a vaccination against a seasonal canine disease.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: The dog belonging to John's cousin, whose photograph John showed James on 7 November 2022; James said Luna was a great name.

entities.name: Stamford
entities.description: The town whose animal shelter James adopted his puppy Ned from in the week before 12 April 2022.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: A country James visited in 2021 and found very beautiful with delicious food; John said he had always dreamed of going there.

entities.name: Turkey
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of 20 April 2022, along with Italy and Mexico.

entities.name: Mexico
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of 20 April 2022, along with Italy and Turkey.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The last country John had visited as of April 2022. He was impressed by its technologically advanced megacities, the huge screens on the buildings and the street food.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: The fourth country James visited. He bought air tickets and flew out on the evening of 11 July 2022 to Toronto, planned to visit Vancouver as well, and planned to return on 20 July 2022 with souvenirs for John and Jill.

entities.name: Toronto
entities.description: The Canadian city James flew to on the evening of 11 July 2022 on the trip that made Canada his fourth country.

entities.name: Vancouver
entities.description: The second Canadian city James planned to visit on his July 2022 trip, besides Toronto.

entities.name: Greenland
entities.description: The country James added to his list during his July 2022 trip by stopping briefly in Nuuk, making it another country on his bucket list.

entities.name: Nuuk
entities.description: The city in Greenland James got out to during his July 2022 trip, staying only a short time but adding one more country to his list.

entities.name: McGee's Pub
entities.description: The pub James proposed to John on 26 August 2022 for its stout, where the two met the next day for a beer instead of coffee. James and Samantha drink there too — she loves its lager — and its being nearby was one of their criteria when they rented an apartment together in October 2022.

entities.name: John's programming course
entities.description: The programming class John signed up for around 17 March 2022 to refresh the HTML and CSS he had learned a few years earlier. He met three new friends on it on 19 April 2022, and his younger siblings joined the same course later, after which he began helping them with their coding.

entities.name: James's game-development course
entities.description: A course combining gaming and programming that James started shortly before 13 June 2022, which he found fun and challenging. On it he worked on a new instalment of a football simulator, his own job being to collect the player databases.

entities.name: John's chess club
entities.description: The chess club John joined in July 2022 to practise with other players, alongside playing mostly online.

entities.name: James's cooking class
entities.description: A cooking class James signed up for on 2 September 2022 at $10 a lesson although he had never liked cooking. In the first lesson he made a good omelette first time and a meringue, and was taught how to make dough.

entities.name: John's online programming group
entities.description: An online programming community John joined on 19 August 2022, full of skilled coders passionate about using technology for good. He shared ideas, exchanged contacts with several members and worked with one of them on a project that week, but called it a one-time experience rather than a return to programming work.

entities.name: James's gaming group
entities.description: The group of gamers James plays with regularly, communicating by voice chat during matches. They stream their sessions, had a get-together in August 2022, and James hosted an all-night gaming marathon with them that he said strengthened their bond.

entities.name: the charitable foundation John built software for
entities.description: A foundation devoted to helping children whose inventory had all been kept on paper and recorded by hand until John volunteered his programming skills in May 2022 and built it a smartphone application for tracking inventory, resources and donations and generating reports.

entities.name: the charity James volunteers with
entities.description: An organisation that provides necessary items to people who are less fortunate. James volunteered with it in May 2022 and offered on 19 June 2022 to take John there the following weekend and introduce him to staff he still knows, telling him no interview is needed.

entities.name: the game-development non-profit
entities.description: The non-profit that emailed John in late September 2022 offering him a volunteer position as a programming mentor for game developers, teaching coding and assisting with their projects — the start, he hoped, of a career combining gaming and helping people.

entities.name: Liverpool
entities.description: The football club James supports. He says there is no sport better than football and no club better than Liverpool, does not miss a single one of their matches, and hoped on 13 June 2022 that they would be champions the following season.

entities.name: Manchester City
entities.description: The football club John supports. On 13 June 2022 he predicted his club and James's would fight for the championship and that City would win, while James called their form bad and their transfer policy terrible; the two bet on which would finish higher.

entities.name: The Witcher 3
entities.description: The role-playing game James was most into in March 2022 for its story and atmosphere, and that John — who had not played it then — was hooked on by August 2022 for its monster-hunter protagonist and its world-shaping choices. It inspired the virtual world James built in April 2022 and, he said in October 2022, his own released game.

entities.name: CS:GO
entities.description: John's favourite game. He played it in an intense tournament at a gaming convention in March 2022, organised a charity tournament for it on 7 May 2022, and named it first when he decided in August 2022 to become an organiser of computer-game competitions in his state.

entities.name: Apex Legends
entities.description: James's favourite game to play with his gaming team, which he praised for awesome graphics and very fast-paced gameplay. It was also one of the games played at John's charity tournament on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Civilization
entities.description: The turn-based strategy series James was playing in April 2022 — John guessed Civilization VI from a screenshot — and had been playing for a month by 29 April. Loving its depth is why he decided in August 2022 to build a strategy game of his own.

entities.name: Total War
entities.description: A strategy series James says he has always loved playing, named alongside Civilization as what made him want to build a strategy game himself.

entities.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
entities.description: The game John was playing at the end of April 2022 and thought was cool.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game John recommended to James on 3 October 2022 for his new video card, praising its immersive world and story. James tried it on 20 October 2022 and found it great and addictive; John warned him the hardest part is choosing right, because even a line of dialogue can change everything.

entities.name: FIFA 23
entities.description: The football game John was hooked on in November 2022, playable online against players all over the world, which he recommended to James as a way into the sports genre.

entities.name: Fortnite
entities.description: A game John said in August 2022 he could host competitions for, and one of the games played at the tournament he held on 30 October 2022 for a children's hospital.

entities.name: Overwatch
entities.description: One of the games John and his gaming friends played at the charity tournament for a children's hospital on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Super Mario
entities.description: One of the two games James played for hours as a child on the Nintendo console that was his first gaming system, and part of what sparked his passion for gaming.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda
entities.description: A game James played for hours as a child on his first Nintendo console, and the comparison he reached for on 20 September 2022 when John described his own 2D adventure game with puzzles.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: The fantasy novel John recommended to James on 29 April 2022, calling it a great novel with awesome writing and part of a trilogy James would love.

entities.name: The Stormlight Archive
entities.description: One of John's two favourite epic fantasy series, recommended to James on 16 June 2022 for its magical world and believable characters.

entities.name: Kingkiller Chronicle
entities.description: One of John's two favourite epic fantasy series, recommended to James on 16 June 2022 for its magical world and believable characters.

entities.name: The Expanse
entities.description: The science-fiction series John recommended to James on 16 June 2022, calling it epic.

entities.name: Dungeons of the Dragon
entities.description: The board game John tried in the week before 18 September 2022 and found very exciting; it is what got him into board games properly.

entities.name: the old Nintendo console
entities.description: The old Nintendo console belonging to James's mother and her army friend, which was James's first gaming system as a child. He played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours, and it is what sparked his passion for gaming; he showed John a photograph of himself playing on it on 21 October 2022.

entities.name: playing video games
entities.description: The shared passion the friendship runs on. James says games give him joy and excitement, are a shared language with other gamers, a refuge in tough times and like therapy when he is overwhelmed; John plays to relax after a long day, to escape stress, and says gaming keeps him focused and motivated in other areas of life.

entities.name: programming
entities.description: Writing code. James tried it in college and says it is now all his life, working in Python and C++. John learned HTML and CSS years earlier, took a class from March 2022, freelanced on a small-business website, blogged about it, built software for a charity, joined an online programming group, taught his siblings and then his parents, ran a seminar and became a mentor.

entities.name: making video games
entities.description: Making games rather than only playing them. James made game mods, built a virtual world, took a game-development course, finished the game he had wanted to make since childhood and built and released a Unity strategy game; John made his first mobile game, collaborated on an online board game and took a mentoring role at a game-development non-profit.

entities.name: chess
entities.description: The game John took up in July 2022 to get better at strategy, playing mostly online and at a club. James advised him to study openings and analyse his own games, and John won the regional chess tournament on 1 November 2022.

entities.name: playing the drums
entities.description: John owns a drum kit and had been playing for a month as of 27 March 2022, having also played when he was younger; James started learning a few days before the same date and was practising daily.

entities.name: bowling
entities.description: James loves bowling and rolled two strikes on 16 March 2022, and wished he and John could play together. John does not like it and says his fingers are too big for it.

entities.name: skateboarding
entities.description: What James and John were both into as ten-year-olds, going to the skate park with a group of friends, helping each other learn tricks and sometimes leaving class early for it. James still rides occasionally and has taught his dogs to balance on a board.

entities.name: reading
entities.description: John is a big reader of science fiction and epic fantasy, bought a lot of books in June 2022 and nearly filled his bookcase, and relaxes by entering authors' imaginative worlds. James likes reading too, bought an illustrated fantasy adventure book on 26 April 2022, and takes a book to the park.

entities.name: metal detecting
entities.description: The hobby John took up in March 2022, walking along beaches with a metal detector looking for something worthwhile. Mostly bottle caps, but also coins a couple of times and once a gold ring.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: Something James had never liked but took up as a new hobby with a class from 2 September 2022, wanting to learn something new and hoping to cook for John once he has learned a little more.

entities.name: extreme sports
entities.description: What James became interested in during the summer of 2022 as a way of taking breaks from his other hobbies: rope jumping on 8 July 2022 from a height of 150 metres, and surfing on 6 July 2022, which he found strangely relaxing.

entities.name: streaming games
entities.description: Broadcasting gameplay. James's gaming group stream their sessions together, and James started streaming himself in September 2022; a stream on the night of 19 September 2022 drew comments from the gaming community that left him stoked and inspired to keep going.

entities.name: travelling
entities.description: Both men enjoy travelling. James had been to Italy, Turkey and Mexico by April 2022 and added Canada and Greenland in July; John's last trip was to Japan and he says chilling with friends and travelling are what motivate him to work. On 20 April 2022 they agreed to go somewhere together the following year, and in November 2022 James took a road trip with his family and dogs.

entities.name: volunteering
entities.description: Using skills and time for causes. John built software for a children's charitable foundation, ran charity gaming tournaments for a dog shelter and a children's hospital, fed homeless people with the surplus, and took a mentoring position at a game-development non-profit; James volunteered with a charity that gives necessities to people in need and offered to take John along.

entities.name: playing board games
entities.description: John played a strategy board game with friends on 27 April 2022, got into board games properly in September 2022 with Dungeons of the Dragon, and in November 2022 helped create an online board game with a game developer.

entities.name: football
entities.description: James says there is no sport better than football, supports Liverpool and does not miss a match; John supports Manchester City, and on 13 June 2022 they bet on which club would finish higher. James's game-development course worked on a football simulator, and John was hooked on FIFA 23 in November 2022.

entities.name: organising gaming tournaments
entities.description: What John turned from a hobby into a career ambition in August 2022: a charity CS:GO tournament on 7 May 2022, an online competition with programmer friends in October, a programming seminar, and a Fortnite, Overwatch and Apex Legends tournament on 30 October 2022 for a children's hospital. He wants to organise state-level competitions and had already made connections to help.

entities.name: James's game from his childhood comics
entities.description: The computer game James had wanted to make since he was a child, grown out of the comics and main-character sketches he drew back then and combining his two passions, gaming and storytelling. He worked on it for months; a bug broke its game mechanics on 29 April 2022 and a group of friends helped him fix it, and he finished it in April 2022, a personal milestone that had required him to learn a new programming language.

entities.name: the dog-walking and pet-care app
entities.description: An application James and John talked about building together on 17 March 2022, after John suggested they might develop mobile apps. It would connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide pet-care information, and its personal touch — owners entering each dog's preferences and needs — was what James said would set it apart.

entities.name: the Witcher-3-inspired virtual world
entities.description: A virtual world James built with one of his gaming friends on 14 April 2022, combining programming and gaming. Its main character's appearance came from a stranger he passed while walking his dogs around the neighbourhood about two weeks earlier, whom he felt he had fallen in love with at first sight and never approached.

entities.name: James's Unity strategy game
entities.description: The strategy game James built in Unity after deciding on 26 August 2022 that he was dying to make one like Civilization. He finished it on about 1 September 2022, found balancing the mechanics and keeping it fair the hard part, and had released it to the gaming community by 13 October 2022 — his first released game, which he said The Witcher 3 had inspired.

entities.name: the small-business website
entities.description: John's first professional project outside his class: a website for a local small business, taken on as freelance work by late April 2022 to sharpen his coding. Progress was slow with hiccups, and getting payments working on it was the hardest part.

entities.name: the charity inventory application
entities.description: The smartphone application John built for a children's charitable foundation in May 2022, replacing paper records and manual inventory with one app that tracks inventory, resources and donations and generates reports for analysis.

entities.name: John's coding blog
entities.description: The blog about coding John started in the week before 16 June 2022, which he found exciting and a little frightening. He shares and tracks his coding journey on it and uses it to connect with other coders.

entities.name: the coding project with John’s siblings
entities.description: A project John built with his younger siblings after they joined his programming course: a simple text-based adventure game they play while working on their coding skills. By September 2022 they were writing their own small programs, basic games and stories.

entities.name: John's first mobile game
entities.description: A 2D adventure game with puzzles and exploration that John worked on secretly for months and announced on 20 September 2022 as launching the following month. He used a game-design book for the puzzles, watches tutorials and follows developer forums, and offered James a chance to test it.

entities.name: John's portable smoker startup
entities.description: A startup making portable smokers that John began on 19 September 2022, having already welded the first one himself out of metal.

entities.name: the online board game
entities.description: A board game John created with a game developer over the weekend of 5–6 November 2022, seeing his own ideas come to life. A demo was about to be released so others could try it and give feedback.

claims.text: James, who likes 2D adventures with puzzles such as The Legend of Zelda, offered to help test John’s mobile game, and John said he would let him know when testing was ready.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John used a book full of tips and insights on game design to create the puzzles in his mobile game, and also watches tutorials and keeps up with developer forums to stay informed.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James recommended a magazine of tutorials, developer interviews and tips as a source for game development, and John said he reads it too and has found it great.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: In the week of 20 September 2022 James’s week was good but he was trying to find a balance between work and other activities, while John’s was chaotic and he was powering through; James told him to take time for himself and John said he would.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James’s strategy game went from an ambition on 26 August 2022 to build something like Civilization, to a finished Unity game on about 1 September 2022, the hard part having been balancing its mechanics and keeping it fair.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John’s relationship with programming shifted over 2022 from taking a class and freelancing to teaching it: he was helping his younger siblings after they joined his course by August 2022, they were writing their own programs by September, and his parents started learning from him shortly before 4 September 2022.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John was emailed in late September 2022 about a volunteer position at a game-development non-profit, something he had wanted to do for a while and which he saw as the perfect start to a career combining his two loves, gaming and helping people.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The non-profit asked John to be a programming mentor for game developers, teaching coding and assisting with their projects, and he was excited to share his knowledge and motivate people passionate about gaming.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John saw the mentoring position as a chance both to help others and to boost his own skills, found it rewarding to see others reach their potential, and hoped it would open more opportunities for him.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James got a new video card in the week before 3 October 2022 and was excited to jump back into gaming with it, being especially into role-playing games.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John recommended Cyberpunk 2077 to James on 3 October 2022, having played it himself and found it awesome with an immersive world and an amazing story, and James was excited to try it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and his programmer friends organised an online competition in the week before 13 October 2022, and he had a blast seeing everyone show off their skills.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James made his first game and released it to the gaming community shortly before 13 October 2022, and found it fulfilling to see players engage with the game world he had created and enjoy something he had put so much work into.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said The Witcher 3, with its amazing world and story, gave him a great deal of the inspiration for creating his own game and pushed him to make something cool.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: After releasing his first game James said his effort had paid off and that he was ready to make more games in different genres and test out new ideas.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James’s apartment lost power on 18 October 2022 just as he reached the big reveal in a game, and he had to wait hours before he could play again.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The power cut on 18 October 2022 cost James some of his game progress because he had forgotten to save, and he resolved to save more often.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John organised a programming seminar in the week before 21 October 2022; it had a great turnout, he learned interesting new things, and he found sharing his knowledge with the group fulfilling.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At his programming seminar John gained insight into various programming approaches and techniques and found it interesting to hear other developers’ ideas and strategies.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John found ideas at the programming seminar he could use in his own work but had not tried them as of 21 October 2022, and was looking forward to experimenting with them.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John promised to send James resources and tutorials on the new programming approaches and techniques he had learned at his seminar.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James’s mother came to see him with her army friend on 19 October 2022 and they had fun; James said the friend is still serving although she retired long ago, and that the two of them used to tell him stories about their time in the military and about their dog.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James has a photograph of himself as a child playing on his mother and her army friend’s old gaming setup — a Nintendo console with the game Mario and, he said, a funny gamepad — which he showed John on 21 October 2022.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The Nintendo was James’s first gaming system as a child; he played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours, and those games introduced him to gaming and sparked the passion he has had ever since.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James tried Cyberpunk 2077 for the first time on 20 October 2022 and found it a great, addictive game.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John told James the most difficult thing in Cyberpunk 2077 is making the right choice, because even the choice of lines in dialogue can send everything wrong, and warned him without spoilers that he does not have to be friends with every character.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John held a gaming tournament with his gaming friends on the night of 30 October 2022, playing Fortnite, Overwatch and Apex Legends, and they raised a decent amount for a children’s hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said the atmosphere at the charity tournament on 30 October 2022 was awesome and competitive and the moment unforgettable, and that it felt good to use their love of gaming for good.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James and Samantha decided in October 2022 to move in together and rented an apartment not far from McGee’s bar; James said it was a mutual and informed decision.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said he and Samantha simply love spending time at McGee’s bar and that being near it was one of their criteria in choosing the apartment they rented.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James set off on a road trip with his family and his dogs on 4 November 2022, enjoying exploring new places and taking in nature with them.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John won the regional chess tournament on 1 November 2022, an intense contest he came out on top of.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Winning the regional chess tournament felt good to John: his hard work and practice had paid off, he had conquered the challenges, and it gave him a huge confidence boost.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John’s strategy in the regional chess tournament was to analyse and anticipate his opponent’s moves so as to stay one step ahead.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John’s tips for improving at chess are studying opening moves and strategies, learning from experienced players and analysing past games; he said the chess advice James gave him in July 2022 had also helped, and he sent James a resource on chess openings.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John was hooked on FIFA 23 in November 2022, a football game that can be played online against players from all over the world.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James decided on 5 November 2022 to try the sports genre with FIFA 23 and go and train first so that he and John could play together; John told him all it takes is a gamepad and a sense of timing.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James and his family were still on their road trip on 7 November 2022 and had already visited his friends Josh and Mark, with whom they had a great time.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John spent the weekend of 5–6 November 2022 working with a game developer on a project, and found it an incredible experience to see his own ideas come to life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John collaborated with a game developer to create an online board game, which he called a fun and unique experience.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: A demo of the online board game John made was about to be released so others could try it, and he was looking forward to their feedback and suggestions; James promised to try it and give his thoughts.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the way to visit Mark and Josh, James and his family stopped at an animal sanctuary full of cute rescue dogs, which made him think of his and John’s love of furry pals.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James wanted to take the rescue dogs at the sanctuary home but stopped himself because he already has three dogs, and said that more than three would be too many.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 7 November 2022 that he still has not got a dog although he very much wants one.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James says having his dogs around brings so much joy and friendship that life would not be the same without them, and that they make even dark days better.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John says dogs bring a daily dose of positivity and happiness, accept people without judgement and are always there for us.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Luna is the name of the dog belonging to John’s cousin, whose photograph John showed James on 7 November 2022; James said it was a great name.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James’s dog household grew over 2022 from Max and Daisy to three after he adopted the puppy Ned in early April, introduced the three to each other on 17 June 2022, and decided in November 2022 that three dogs is as many as he wants.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John’s charity gaming ran from a CS:GO tournament on 7 May 2022 for a dog shelter near his street to a Fortnite, Overwatch and Apex Legends tournament on 30 October 2022 for a children’s hospital, by way of his decision in August 2022 to make organising tournaments his career.
claims.speaker: John
